A factory's definition.

Fields are listed in the schema's order, each nested under the field that holds it. The fields under an array are those of each of its elements, and the fields under a map are those of each of its values.

## kind

`"Factory"`, required.

## spec

object, required.

- `stations`: array of object, required. The line, in &lt;flow&gt; order.
  - `id`: string matching `^[a-z]+$`, required. The station's id.
  - `wip`: integer, default `2`. Items at once.
  - `kind`: one of `"agent"`, `"human"`.
- `labels`: map of string.
- `connections`: array of string matching `^[a-z]+$` or object.
  - `name`: string matching `^[a-z]+$`, required.
  - `type`: one of `"mcp"`, `"aws"`, required.
  - `url`: string (uri), required; only when `type` is `"mcp"`.
  - `network`: boolean, default `false`; only when `type` is `"mcp"`.
